title: Dynamic filter Mirror code generator
hypothesis: An input-generated three-angle Givens code on one shared operator retains held-out quality while reducing actual bytes and operator-generation work versus a generic dynamic-filter generator.
mirror_coordinate: input-generated three Givens angles applied as two left and one right plane rotations to the shared operator
controls: generic input-to-96-filter hypernetwork (mandatory Dynamic Filter Network control)
fixture: non-convolutional dynamic linear projection: y=W(x)x; teacher W(x) is a softmax mixture of four random 8x12 operator bases with coefficients from a 12->4 tanh->4 generator

development.selection_metric: held-out normalized MSE; fixed configuration across both worlds

fresh.run_only_if: development gates pass in both worlds

storage.format: torch.save state_dict + method metadata to BytesIO

compute.proxy: MAC proxy for code/filter generation, three Givens operator rotations or basis assembly, and dynamic linear projection per example

success_gate: Fresh Mirror MSE <=1.10x shared-basis control in both worlds; payload <=0.75x generic full-filter hypernetwork; compute proxy <=1.5x shared-basis control.
failure_gate: Any development quality/byte/compute gate fails; fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic mechanism screen only; no natural Transformer or capacity claim.
Oracle teacher is privileged and not deployable.
